newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet firmer with IPE, physical market cautious.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet firmer with IPE, physical market cautious.

text.p: NWE jet fuel prices leapt higher on Wednesday as underlying Oct IPE gas oil futures gained $7.50, but the huge leap dulled prompt physical trade, dealers said.
The huge backwardation in the gas oil futures market more than negated the contango in jet fuel forward prices.
A U.K. major working a 10,000 tonne stem at a quotes-related price into Bordeaux said the bid/offer spread was still 50 cents. Larger cargoes were offered around Oct IPE +$37 cif NWE.
Barge trade was quiet after a parcel traded on Tuesday at Oct IPE +$31 fob Rotterdam.
